remarks: Come see this beautiful, sunny 2nd floor 1 bedroom apartment located at Woodside Green in the heart of Stamford. Features gleaming hardwood floors, large living room, updated kitchen and bathroom. Hot water and cooking gas included in rent. The complex is set on park-like grounds with gazebo, grilling area and walking paths. Pet friendly complex, coin operated laundry on the premises and plenty of off street parking. Fabulous location and commuter's delight, the Stamford train station, I-95 and Merritt Parkway are short drive away. Across the street from shopping, restaurants, LA Fitness. Must see!! Each prospective tenant must have over 700 FICO score with employment verification.
